rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a hair comb.

example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 baa2 san1 so1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for grooming hair or fur with a comb.

example.english: I comb my hair when I get up in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 wui5 so1 tau4

rows.note: Use this when searching an area thoroughly from one end to the other.

example.english: We comb through the whole house starting from the entrance.
example.traditional: 我哋由門口開始，將成間屋搵勻。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau4 mun4 hau2 hoi1 ci2 zoeng1 seng4 gaan1 uk1 wan2 wan4
